svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 2,450 mm of 40 x 2 mm 6061-T6 tube; square and deburr both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the bottom end. Drill two 12 mm holes through one wall

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only and fit a rubber grommet in each:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: - at 1,220 mm, on the side that will face east (away from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wall), for the humidity sensor lead;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: - at 1,250 mm, turned 90 degrees to face south (toward the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pull the mast cable through the tube before the end cap goes on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plastic end cap with its grommet goes in the bottom end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the mast-top sleeve slides 40 mm over the top end (two set screws).
